seo.title: Karim Matar - Full-stack developer
seo.description: Karim Matar is a full-stack developer in Belgium. He builds web apps with React and Next.js, and works on the server side with Laravel, PHP and Node.js. Have a look at his projects or send him a message.

hero.headlineAccessible: web apps, interfaces, design systems, realtime features and APIs
hero.subtext: I trained as a full-stack developer and I like working on both sides of it. I take a feature from the database up to the interface, and I care about how it works and how it looks in equal measure.

projects.title: Projects I finished
projects.text: Every one of them is online, and each covers the database, the API, the interface and the deployment. Open a project to try it.

list.title: LexiPlay
list.description: A web app where children with dyslexia learn new words by playing games and taking quizzes.

list.title: Donation app
list.description: A donation page with Mollie payments, built for visitors of De Warmste Week.

list.title: Doodley
list.description: A drawing game for friends or family. Someone draws, everyone else guesses, in real time.

list.title: JobFalcon
list.description: A private Telegram bot I built for my own job search. It hunts software engineering vacancies in the UK that offer visa sponsorship, verifies the sponsorship from each listing's own wording, and ranks the best matches for my profile.

about.title: Database to interface
body: I work end to end: database, APIs, business logic and the interface on top. I like both sides of that. I am as happy inside a data model or an API as I am on a layout, an empty state, or an error someone hits at the worst possible moment.

I like a codebase that stays easy to read. Components with one job, names that say what they do without a comment, and one set of colour and spacing values instead of a new one every time. Performance and accessibility go into the first version, not into a cleanup afterwards.
Outside client work I build small things to keep an eye on detail. This site is where I test layout, motion and multilingual support.
about.pullQuote: I work on both sides of the stack, and I like both.
